title: Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder
abstract: arXiv:2608.27044v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal representation learning has been shifting from traditional two-tower architectures to large language model (LLM)-based embedders due to their strong instruction-following capabilities. Despite this progress, existing approaches primarily focus on language and image modalities, which also remain the dominant modalities for user-conditioned interactions in current embedders. In this paper, we propose the first Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder (OmniUE), which not only learns a unified embedding space across text, video, and audio by leveraging intermediate-layer representations from dedicated learnable tokens, but also supports omni-interactive querying, enabling users to provide inputs in the form of text, visual regions of interest, and audio spans. Within OmniUE, visual and audio segmenters process diverse user interactions and integrate them with an omni-LLM to produce user-conditioned any-to-any embeddings via context agg

translated_abstract: 多模态表示学习正从传统的双塔架构转向基于大型语言模型（LLM）的嵌入器，这得益于其强大的指令遵循能力。尽管取得了这些进展，现有方法主要集中于语言和图像模态，这些仍然是当前嵌入器中用户条件交互的主要模态。在本文中，我们提出了首个全交互通用嵌入器（OmniUE），它不仅通过利用专用可学习令牌的中间层表示，在文本、视频和音频之间学习统一的嵌入空间，还支持全交互查询，使用户能够以文本、视觉感兴趣区域和音频片段的形式提供输入。在OmniUE中，视觉和音频分割器处理多样的用户交互，并将其与全LLM集成，通过上下文聚合生成用户条件下的任意到任意嵌入。
tldr: 提出了首个全交互通用嵌入器（OmniUE），统一了文本、视频和音频的嵌入空间，并支持文本、视觉区域和音频片段的全交互查询。
en_tdlr: Introduces the first Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder (OmniUE), which unifies embeddings across text, video, and audio while enabling omni-interactive queries via text, visual regions, and audio spans.
